annotations.title: Start a track from where its rows come from

description: Starts tracking from a hack instead of a template, in one step: a service like Shopify or Instagram (a ready id from find_templates' hacks or find_hacks) or a community email hack for a sender like a bank (its id). It builds the topic's template, or uses the person's own track on that topic when they have one; a topic with no template gets a sheet of its columns on the TrackerHacker starter, and a hack that fills no topic gets a private topic made from what it reads (local is then sheet or topic). Then it turns the hack on with its setup steps. When the topic has more than one template it changes nothing and gives back choose: show the person those templates (name, author, copies) and call again with the templateId they pick. Show the person the template first, as with install_template, and say they can start from the plain TrackerHacker starter instead (starter: true).

hackId.description: A ready-made source's id (like shopify) or a community hack's id.

starter.description: true makes a sheet of the topic's columns on the TrackerHacker starter instead of a template, when the person would rather start plain. Always an option.

templateId.description: The template's spreadsheetId, when the topic has more than one and the person picked one.

topic.description: Only for a hack that fills more than one topic: the topic id to start on.

name: start_from_hack
title: Start a track from where its rows come from
